## Technical aspects

Titanium Dioxide occurs naturally in many minerals. For industrial purposes, it is mined and then crushed, ground or refined, depending on its intended use. Titanium Dioxide is a white, water-insoluble solid that comes in the form of a white powder.

## Storage period

The shelf life of Titanium Dioxide is indefinite when stored properly.

## Packaging

Foodcom supplies its Business Partners with Titanium Dioxide in 25 kg bags.

## Application

Titanium Dioxide is used in a wide variety of products: paints and varnishes, orthodontic composites, dietary supplements, and cosmetics (in sunscreen lotions, day creams, foundations and lip balms). Titanium Dioxide protects cosmetics from oxidation and loss of their protective properties when exposed to the sun. It does not leave white spots and is safe for use on sensitive skin. Titanium Dioxide is also used in products that require white color or brightening as a white pigment.

  *   *   *   *   *   *   *   * ## TITANIUM DIOXIDE

grades PRETIOX^{®} have optimal average particle size and very narrow particle size distribution, high tinting strength, neutral or slightly blue undertone. High reflectance in the wavelength range of visible light and their high light-scattering power in common paint media are another important features. The low difference in a range of optical parameters brings a stable colour shade and enables application in different tinting system especially in case of use of micronized rutile grades. Effective surface treatment minimises flocculation in a number of paint systems and allows easy processing during application with good following stability in paint systems.
Titanium dioxide PRETIOX^{®}CG is a very effective inorganic photocatalyst for removing some organic and inorganic pollutants (above all NO_{X}). When illuminated with UV light (below 380 nm), electron-hole pairs are generated in valence and conduction bands. The oxidative reaction in the presence of molecules of water or oxygen results in creating surface radicals. They attack molecules of pollutants and cause their degradation.

PRETIOX^{®}CG types are suitable for any photocatalytic application from air pollution treatment, organic substances decomposition, photocatalytic products or surfaces to cleaning troublesome water organic pollution.

## Description

We have been working with Grupa Azoty Z.Ch. “Police” S.A. since 1990 and distribute Tytanpol® qualities in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the Netherlands.
For over 50 years, Grupa Azoty “Police” S.A. has been one of the largest chemical plants in Poland and an important player on the European market. As Poland’s largest exporter of titanium dioxide, chemicals and fertilizers, Grupa Azoty Police has established itself in many markets around the world.
40 years of expertise in the production of titanium dioxide pigments and the investments made in recent years enable Grupa Azoty to constantly improve the quality and thus the competitiveness of its products.
The qualities of the TYTANPOL® series are characterized by the following properties: high brightness, good brightening power, high opacity, easy dispersion and stability in various coating systems for a wide range of applications.
Tytanpol® titanium dioxide pigments are produced using the sulphate method on the basis of a license from Kronos GmbH. The current technology for the production of titanium dioxide allows the production of various rutile types, of which Tytanpol® R-001, R-003, R-210 and R-211 are permanently available.
